interpretation_boundary.input_after_calibration: SET voltage waveform, RESET voltage waveform and gate voltage
interpretation_boundary.set_transport: effective pre-SET field-assisted and connected super-ohmic envelopes, coupled to the measured positive transistor load line
interpretation_boundary.set_state: irreversible observable connected fraction driven by voltage-domain exposure; not a filament radius or vacancy concentration
interpretation_boundary.set_reset_link: paired-data protocol transfer factor; not a microscopic retention or ion-migration efficiency
interpretation_boundary.reset: measured reverse-transistor load line, internal-field state and effective field-assisted HRS transport
interpretation_boundary.reset_transition_modes: same-protocol 1.1-V state law improves random holdout; the 0.9/1.3-V prior is retained for late-cycle robustness
interpretation_boundary.nonstationarity: RESET transition threshold shifts between early and late cycle groups and is not predictable from voltage input alone
interpretation_boundary.time_limitation: quasi-static DC waveform model; changing physical dwell time or pulse width is outside the current validation domain
interpretation_boundary.mechanism_limitation: electrical curves do not uniquely distinguish boron-vacancy and metal-assisted paths
